labels.STORY_CHART_1_ROLE: Tracks final and primary energy consumption against policy indicators.
labels.STORY_CHART_1_WHAT: Compares final and primary energy consumption levels and their recent direction.
labels.STORY_CHART_1_HOW: Reads the latest value, yearly change and long-term change from the time series.
labels.STORY_CHART_1_READ: Lower consumption for similar activity usually indicates better efficiency.
labels.STORY_CHART_2_ROLE: Shows the share of renewable energy across total, transport, electricity and heating/cooling.
labels.STORY_CHART_2_WHAT: Shows how much of energy demand is covered by renewables.
labels.STORY_CHART_2_HOW: Uses percentage shares and their change in percentage points over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_2_READ: Higher renewable shares generally signal progress in transition.
labels.STORY_CHART_3_ROLE: Shows greenhouse gas emissions by source category.
labels.STORY_CHART_3_WHAT: Identifies which source contributes most to energy-related emissions.
labels.STORY_CHART_3_HOW: Ranks source categories by latest value and checks their trend over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_3_READ: Falling emissions are usually favourable for climate objectives.
labels.STORY_CHART_4_ROLE: Shows how much energy is used per unit of economic output.
labels.STORY_CHART_4_WHAT: Measures energy used to produce one unit of economic output.
labels.STORY_CHART_4_HOW: Tracks the intensity indicator level and its short- and long-term changes.
labels.STORY_CHART_4_READ: Lower intensity means less energy needed for the same output.
labels.STORY_CHART_5_ROLE: Shows economic output generated per unit of energy used.
labels.STORY_CHART_5_WHAT: Measures how much economic value is created per unit of energy.
labels.STORY_CHART_5_HOW: Tracks the productivity indicator and compares current vs past values.
labels.STORY_CHART_5_READ: Higher productivity usually means energy is used more efficiently.
labels.STORY_CHART_6_ROLE: Shows dependency on energy imports by product.
labels.STORY_CHART_6_WHAT: Shows how much the energy system relies on imported energy.
labels.STORY_CHART_6_HOW: Calculates dependency ratios and compares them over time by product.
labels.STORY_CHART_6_READ: Lower dependency generally implies lower exposure to external shocks.
labels.STORY_CHART_7_TITLE: Fossil fuels in gross available energy
labels.STORY_CHART_7_ROLE: Shows the share of fossil fuels in gross available energy.
labels.STORY_CHART_7_WHAT: Shows the fossil fuel share in total available energy.
labels.STORY_CHART_7_HOW: Uses share indicators and percentage-point changes across years.
labels.STORY_CHART_7_READ: A declining fossil share indicates a cleaner supply mix.
labels.STORY_CHART_8_ROLE: Provides demographic context for energy indicators.
labels.STORY_CHART_8_WHAT: Provides population context to interpret energy indicators fairly.
labels.STORY_CHART_8_HOW: Displays demographic levels and trends that can explain energy demand shifts.
labels.STORY_CHART_8_READ: Use as background context, not as a good-or-bad performance metric.
labels.STORY_CHART_9_ROLE: Shows which energy products dominate final consumption.
labels.STORY_CHART_9_WHAT: Shows which fuels/products contribute most to final energy use.
labels.STORY_CHART_9_HOW: Ranks products by latest value and their share of the total.
labels.STORY_CHART_9_READ: Interpret changes with structural and policy context, not direction alone.
labels.STORY_CHART_10_ROLE: Shows which sectors consume the most final energy.
labels.STORY_CHART_10_WHAT: Shows sectoral distribution of final energy consumption.
labels.STORY_CHART_10_HOW: Compares sector series and highlights top contributors and shares.
labels.STORY_CHART_10_READ: Use to identify demand structure before judging trend quality.
labels.STORY_CHART_11_ROLE: Breaks down household energy consumption by end use.
labels.STORY_CHART_11_WHAT: Explains where household energy is used (heating, appliances, etc.).
labels.STORY_CHART_11_HOW: Finds leading end uses and follows their trend over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_11_READ: Direction depends on weather, efficiency and social context.
labels.STORY_CHART_12_ROLE: Shows the fuel mix used in transport.
labels.STORY_CHART_12_WHAT: Shows which fuels power the transport sector.
labels.STORY_CHART_12_HOW: Compares fuel series, identifies the top fuel and its trend.
labels.STORY_CHART_12_READ: Assess with mobility demand and decarbonisation context together.
labels.STORY_CHART_13_ROLE: Shows the fuel mix used in road transport.
labels.STORY_CHART_13_WHAT: Focuses on fuel use specifically in road transport.
labels.STORY_CHART_13_HOW: Ranks road-fuel series by latest values and tracks their trend.
labels.STORY_CHART_13_READ: Use with fleet and technology context to interpret shifts.
labels.STORY_CHART_14_ROLE: Shows energy use in commercial and public services.
labels.STORY_CHART_14_WHAT: Shows how service activities consume energy by product/fuel.
labels.STORY_CHART_14_HOW: Highlights top consuming products and their trend over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_14_READ: Interpret with activity growth and efficiency changes together.
labels.STORY_CHART_15_ROLE: Shows the fuel mix used by industry.
labels.STORY_CHART_15_WHAT: Shows which fuels are most used in industrial activity.
labels.STORY_CHART_15_HOW: Compares fuel contributions and their long-term movement.
labels.STORY_CHART_15_READ: Judge trends with industrial output and technology context.
labels.STORY_CHART_16_ROLE: Shows products used for non-energy purposes.
labels.STORY_CHART_16_WHAT: Tracks products used as feedstock or materials rather than fuel.
labels.STORY_CHART_16_HOW: Identifies dominant non-energy products and their trend.
labels.STORY_CHART_16_READ: Changes often reflect industrial structure, not only efficiency.
labels.STORY_CHART_17_ROLE: Shows gross electricity and derived heat production by source.
labels.STORY_CHART_17_WHAT: Shows how electricity and heat generation are split by source.
labels.STORY_CHART_17_HOW: Compares source contributions and changes in the generation mix.
labels.STORY_CHART_17_READ: Use to monitor diversification and decarbonisation patterns.
labels.STORY_CHART_18_ROLE: Shows electricity production from combustible fuel types.
labels.STORY_CHART_18_WHAT: Details electricity output from combustible fuel categories.
labels.STORY_CHART_18_HOW: Breaks down generation by fuel type and tracks trend shifts.
labels.STORY_CHART_18_READ: Interpret with transition pace and security constraints in mind.
labels.STORY_CHART_19_ROLE: Shows population unable to keep home adequately warm.
labels.STORY_CHART_19_WHAT: Measures social exposure to insufficient home heating conditions.
labels.STORY_CHART_19_HOW: Uses survey-based population shares and their trend over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_19_READ: Lower values indicate lower energy poverty risk.
labels.STORY_CHART_20_ROLE: Shows the share of final energy consumption that is electrified, by sector.
labels.STORY_CHART_20_WHAT: Shows how much of final energy use is met directly by electricity, overall and by sector.
labels.STORY_CHART_20_HOW: Tracks the electrification share for each sector and its change over time.
labels.STORY_CHART_20_READ: A rising share generally signals progress in electrifying energy demand.
labels.STORY_CHART_21_WHAT: Shows total available energy split by product categories.
labels.STORY_CHART_21_HOW: Finds largest product contributions and their relative share.
labels.STORY_CHART_21_READ: Use to understand supply structure before comparing levels.
labels.STORY_CHART_22_ROLE: Shows total energy supply by product.
labels.STORY_CHART_22_WHAT: Shows how total energy supply is distributed across products.
labels.STORY_CHART_22_HOW: Ranks product series by latest value and share of total supply.
labels.STORY_CHART_22_READ: Interpret trends with structural changes in energy mix.
labels.GROUP_HEADLINE_DESC: Core indicators used to understand energy transition progress.
labels.GROUP_HEADLINE_WHY: These indicators provide the main policy signal for energy transition progress.
labels.GROUP_SECURITY_DESC: Dependence on imports and fossil fuels.
labels.GROUP_SECURITY_WHY: This theme highlights exposure to external supply risks and fossil reliance.
labels.GROUP_SUPPLY_DESC: Gross available energy and total energy supply.
labels.GROUP_SUPPLY_WHY: This theme explains the composition and level of available energy supply.
labels.GROUP_CONSUMPTION_DESC: How final energy consumption is distributed by product and sector.
labels.GROUP_CONSUMPTION_WHY: This theme explains where final energy is used and by whom.
labels.GROUP_TRANSPORT_DESC: Fuel use in transport and road transport.
labels.GROUP_TRANSPORT_WHY: This theme shows how transport demand is met by different fuels.
labels.GROUP_INDUSTRY_DESC: Energy and non-energy consumption in industrial activities.
labels.GROUP_INDUSTRY_WHY: This theme tracks industrial demand and non-energy uses of products.
labels.GROUP_ELECTRICITY_DESC: Electricity and heat generation by source and fuel.
labels.GROUP_ELECTRICITY_WHY: This theme describes electricity and heat generation structure.
labels.GROUP_ENVIRONMENT_DESC: Greenhouse gas emissions linked to energy activity.
labels.GROUP_ENVIRONMENT_WHY: This theme links energy activity to environmental pressure.
labels.GROUP_PERFORMANCE_WHY: This theme measures how efficiently energy supports economic activity.
labels.GROUP_HOUSEHOLDS_WHY: This theme focuses on residential demand and end-use patterns.
labels.GROUP_SOCIAL_WHY: This theme reflects household living-condition risks linked to energy.
labels.GROUP_MARKET_DESC: Electricity market structure and concentration indicators.
labels.GROUP_MARKET_WHY: This theme captures market concentration and competition signals.
labels.GROUP_CONTEXT_WHY: This theme provides supporting context for interpreting other indicators.
labels.GROUP_OTHER_DESC: Additional indicators in the current view.
labels.GROUP_OTHER_WHY: This theme contains additional indicators not mapped to a primary category.
labels.THEME_SUSTAINABILITY_DESC: Renewable energy share, emissions intensity and household energy affordability.
labels.THEME_SUSTAINABILITY_WHY: This theme tracks progress towards a cleaner and more affordable energy system.
labels.THEME_DIVERSIFICATION_DESC: Energy supply composition, import dependency and the fossil fuel share.
labels.THEME_DIVERSIFICATION_WHY: This theme shows how exposed the energy supply is to a narrow set of sources or suppliers.
labels.THEME_EFFICIENCY_DESC: Energy efficiency, intensity and productivity indicators.
labels.THEME_EFFICIENCY_WHY: This theme measures how much energy is needed to support economic activity.
labels.THEME_ELECTRIFICATION_DESC: Electricity and heat production, and the rate of electrification by sector.
labels.THEME_ELECTRIFICATION_WHY: This theme tracks the shift from fossil fuels to electricity across sectors.
labels.THEME_CONSUMPTION_DESC: Final energy consumption by product, sector and end use.
labels.THEME_CONSUMPTION_WHY: This theme explains where and how final energy is actually used.
labels.THEME_OILSTOCKS_DESC: Oil stock levels and security of supply.
labels.THEME_OILSTOCKS_WHY: Oil stocks show how much of a buffer countries hold; comparing stocks with deliveries and with the period average shows where supply is comfortable or tight.
labels.STORY_CHART_23_ROLE: Compares road diesel closing stocks and deliveries over the last 12 months.
labels.STORY_CHART_23_WHAT: Puts road diesel closing stocks next to deliveries for the latest 12 months, with the 12 months before for comparison.
labels.STORY_CHART_23_HOW: Takes the newest month published for the selected country, then reads the latest value, the change on the previous month and over the period.
labels.STORY_CHART_23_READ: Stocks that stay high while deliveries fall can signal weaker demand; falling stocks with steady deliveries signal tighter supply.
labels.STORY_CHART_25_ROLE: Compares kerosene-type jet fuel closing stocks and deliveries over the last 12 months.
labels.STORY_CHART_25_WHAT: Puts jet fuel closing stocks next to deliveries for the latest 12 months, with the 12 months before for comparison.
labels.STORY_CHART_25_HOW: Takes the newest month published for the selected country, then reads the latest value, the change on the previous month and over the period.
labels.STORY_CHART_25_READ: Stocks that stay high while deliveries fall can signal weaker demand; falling stocks with steady deliveries signal tighter supply.
labels.STORY_CHART_24_ROLE: Ranks countries by road diesel closing stocks over the last 12 months.
labels.STORY_CHART_24_WHAT: Shows every country's closing stock month by month and which countries hold the most.
labels.STORY_CHART_24_HOW: Ranks all countries by their latest published month and reads each one's trend over the period.
labels.STORY_CHART_24_READ: A large and rising stock is a bigger buffer; compare countries against the period average shown in the chart.
labels.STORY_CHART_26_ROLE: Ranks countries by kerosene-type jet fuel closing stocks over the last 12 months.
labels.STORY_CHART_26_WHAT: Shows every country's closing stock month by month and which countries hold the most.
labels.STORY_CHART_26_HOW: Ranks all countries by their latest published month and reads each one's trend over the period.
labels.STORY_CHART_26_READ: A large and rising stock is a bigger buffer; compare countries against the period average shown in the chart.
